## What you already checked

<!-- `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/DAEMON_SLAYER.md`, `docs/adr/`,
     `ROADMAP.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, or the code itself. Saying where you looked
     stops the answer being a link you already read.

     Two of those are worth naming specifically: `docs/adr/` records decisions
     that were already argued and settled, and CLAUDE.md carries a "Settled -
     do not re-litigate" list. If your idea is in either, it is not
     automatically closed - but it needs new evidence rather than a restatement. -->
